Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代时候：古代的时候，The time phrase needs 的 before 时候 when the preceding time word has more than one syllable. [teacher rule: de_shihou]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to a concrete group of people in the story, so the plural noun is needed rather than the generic noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This later occurrence also refers to the people whom 神农 teaches, so use the concrete-group noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么植物是安全什么是危险：什么植物是安全的，什么植物是危险的，When an adjective follows 是 in this classification structure, it needs 的; the two parallel embedded clauses also need to be separated. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他们能吃什么植物：什么植物能吃，The subject has already appeared in the same clause, so omit the repeated pronoun; this also makes the embedded question more natural. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase rather than using only his name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉：神农出去试很多种植物，告诉了，Testing many kinds is not a brief trial, so do not use the reduplicated verb; in this series of actions, the final completed action takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
8. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 但是不知道为什么，没有办法：因为不知道为什么，所以没有办法，The second idea gives the reason for having no solution, not a contrast, so use the cause-and-effect connector. [rule: none]

items.reason: 古代 is multisyllabic, so it needs 的 before 时候 under the teacher's rule.
This refers to the people in the story, so 人们 is required by the teacher's rule.
In 告诉人什么植物……, 人 can generically mean people, and the teacher did not mark it.
The predicates need 的 here: 是安全的，是危险的.
他们 is acceptable in the embedded question and is not an unnecessary repetition within the same clause.
神农 is first introduced here, so the teacher's reference rule requires a brief identifying noun phrase.
The final action in the action sequence needs 了, but the displayed correction itself ends unfinished at 告诉了.
但是不知道为什么，没有办法 is an acceptable narrative continuation; a 因为……所以 rewrite is optional rather than required.
